1. (Currently amended) A system for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including means for use in generating user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing a distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and showing the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing a risk tolerance level of the investor, __wherein the system further comprises means for automatically comparing the distribution of assets of the investments of the investment portfolio with the distribution of assets of the benchmark risk category and generating a comparison metric indicative of the degree of correspondence between said distributions__.

2. (Currently amended) The system claimed in claim 1, wherein each asset class of the one or more asset classes of a distribution of assets of an investment is shown as a proportion of the investor's assets allocated to the respective investment, __and wherein the system further comprises means for displaying said comparison metric on the user interface__.

3. (Previously presented) The system claimed in claim 1 or claim 2, wherein said user interface shows the sum of the distribution of assets in each asset class of said asset classes of the investments of the investment portfolio.

4. (Currently amended) A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including __means for use in modifying the composition of the investment portfolio based on the comparison metric generated by the analysing system__.

5. (Currently amended) A system for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said system including the system for analysing claimed in any one of claims 1 to 3 and including __means for use in adjusting the allocation of the investor's assets among the investments of the investment portfolio based on the comparison metric generated by the analysing system__.

6. (Currently amended) The system claimed in claim 4 or claim 5, said system for performing the step of __dynamically__ allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to an investment of the investment portfolio __in response to changes in the comparison metric__.

7. (Currently amended) A system for creating an investment portfolio for an investor, said system for performing the steps of: (a) categorising the investor as one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories; (b) generating user interface data for display of a user interface on a user terminal, the user interface showing a plurality of investments and including means for selecting investments for inclusion in the investment portfolio; and (c) generating further user interface data for display of another user interface, said another user interface showing the distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and also showing a distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor, __and further comprising means for automatically comparing the distribution of assets of the selected investments with the distribution of assets of the benchmark risk category and generating a comparison metric indicative of the degree of correspondence between said distributions__.

8. (Currently amended) The system claimed in claim 7, wherein each asset class of the one or more asset classes of a distribution of assets of an investment is shown as a proportion of the investor's assets allocated to the respective investment, __and wherein the system further comprises means for displaying said comparison metric on said another user interface__.

9. (Currently amended) The system claimed in claim 7 or claim 8, said another user interface including __means for dynamically allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to each investment of the investment portfolio in response to the comparison metric__.

10. (Previously presented) The system claimed in any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are fund managers.

11. (Previously presented) The system claimed in any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are direct shares.

12. (Currently amended) A computer program for analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, said program for performing the step of generating a user interface for display on a user terminal, said user interface showing the distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and also showing a distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor, __and further performing the step of automatically comparing the distribution of assets of the investments of the investment portfolio with the distribution of assets of the benchmark risk category and generating a comparison metric indicative of the degree of correspondence between said distributions__.

13. (Currently amended) The computer program claimed in claim 12, wherein each asset class of the one or more asset classes of a distribution of assets of an investment is shown as a proportion of the investor's assets allocated to the respective investment, __and wherein the program further performs the step of displaying said comparison metric on the user interface__.

14. (Currently amended) The computer program claimed in claim 12 or claim 13, wherein said user interface shows the sum of the distribution of assets in each asset class of said asset classes of the investments of the investment portfolio, __and wherein the program further performs the step of updating said sum in response to changes in the investor's asset allocations__.

15. (Currently amended) A computer program for managing an investment portfolio of an investor, said computer program for performing the steps claimed in any one of claims 12 to 14 and performing the step of __modifying the composition of the investment portfolio based on the comparison metric generated by the analysing steps__.

17. (Currently amended) The computer program claimed in claim 15 or claim 16, said computer program for performing the step of __dynamically allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to an investment of the investment portfolio in response to changes in the comparison metric__.

18. (Currently amended) A computer program for creating an investment portfolio for an investor, said computer program for performing the steps of: (a) categorising the investor as one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories; (b) generating user interface data for display of a user interface on a user terminal, the user interface showing a plurality of investments and including means for selecting investments for inclusion in the investment portfolio; and (c) generating further user interface data for display of another user interface on said user terminal, said another user interface showing the distribution of assets of each investment of the investment portfolio over one or more asset classes and also showing the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor, __and further performing the step of automatically comparing the distribution of assets of the selected investments with the distribution of assets of the benchmark risk category and generating a comparison metric indicative of the degree of correspondence between said distributions__.

19. (Currently amended) The computer program claimed in claim 18, wherein each asset class of the one or more asset classes of a distribution of assets of an investment is shown as a proportion of the investor's assets allocated to the respective investment, __and wherein the program further performs the step of displaying said comparison metric on said another user interface__.

20. (Currently amended) The computer program claimed in claim 18 or claim 19, said another user interface including __means for dynamically allocating a proportion of the investor's assets to each investment of the investment portfolio in response to the comparison metric__.

22. (Previously presented) The computer program claimed in any one of claims 18 to 20, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are direct shares.

23. (Cancelled)

24. (Currently amended) A method of analysing risk associated with an investment portfolio of an investor, including the steps of: (a) arranging investments of the investment portfolio to show a distribution of assets of each investment of said investments over one or more asset classes; (b) determining the degree to which the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said investments corresponds to the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of a benchmark risk category representing the risk tolerance level of the investor; and (c) __automatically generating a comparison metric indicative of said degree of correspondence and displaying said comparison metric to the investor__.

25. (Currently amended) The method claimed in claim 24, wherein each asset class of the one or more asset classes of a distribution of assets of an investment is shown as a proportion of the investor's assets allocated to the respective investment, __and wherein the method further includes the step of updating said proportions in response to changes in the investor's asset allocations__.

26. (Currently amended) The method claimed in claim 24 or claim 25, wherein said step of determining includes the step of determining the degree to which the sum of the distribution of assets in each asset class of said asset classes of the investments of the investment portfolio corresponds to the distribution of assets over each corresponding asset class of the asset classes of the benchmark risk category, __and wherein the method further includes the step of displaying said sum and the corresponding benchmark distribution to the investor__.

27. (Previously presented) The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 26, wherein said step of arranging is effected by a computer program being executed on a user terminal.

28. (Currently amended) A method of managing an investment portfolio of an investor, including the steps of: (a) analysing the risk associated with the investment portfolio by performing the method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 27; and (b) __dynamically changing one or more of the investments or the allocation of assets to investments in response to said step of analysing so that the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said investments of the investment portfolio corresponds more closely to the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of the benchmark risk category of the investor__.

29. (Currently amended) A method of managing an investment portfolio of an investor, including the steps of: (a) analysing the risk associated with the investment portfolio by performing the method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 27; and (b) __dynamically changing the proportion of investor's assets allocated to each investment of the investment portfolio so that the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said investments corresponds more closely to the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of the benchmark risk category of the investor__.

30. (Previously presented) The method claimed in claim 28 or in claim 29, wherein the step of changing is effected by a computer program being executed on a user terminal.

31. (Currently amended) The method claimed in claim 29 or in claim 30, including the step of __dynamically changing one or more of the investments in response to said step of analysing so that the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of said investments of the investment portfolio corresponds more closely to the distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes of the benchmark risk category of the investor__.

32. (Previously presented) The method claimed in claim 31, wherein the step of changing one or more of the investments is effected by a computer program being executed on a user terminal.

33. (Currently amended) The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 32, including the step of __automatically forecasting the performance of the investment portfolio over a predetermined period for a predetermined amount of the investor's assets based on historical performance data and the comparison metric__.

34. (Currently amended) A method of creating an investment portfolio for an investor, including the steps of: (a) categorising the investor as one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories; (b) selecting a plurality of investments for the investment portfolio; and (c) analysing the risk associated with the investment portfolio by performing the method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 27, wherein said one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories represents the risk tolerance level of the investor, __and further including the step of automatically generating a comparison metric indicative of the degree of correspondence between the distribution of assets of the selected investments and the distribution of assets of the benchmark risk category__.

35. (Currently amended) A method of creating an investment portfolio for an investor, including the steps of: (a) categorising the investor as one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories; (b) selecting a plurality of investments for the investment portfolio; and (c) managing the investment portfolio by performing the method claimed in any one of claims 28 to 33, wherein said one of a plurality of benchmark risk categories represents the risk tolerance level of the investor, __and further including the step of automatically generating a comparison metric indicative of the degree of correspondence between the distribution of assets of the selected investments and the distribution of assets of the benchmark risk category__.

36. (Previously presented) The method claimed in claim 34 or in claim 35, wherein the step of categorising is effected by a computer program being executed on a user terminal.

37. (Previously presented) The method claimed in claim 34 or in claim 35, wherein the step of selecting is effected by a computer program being executed on a user terminal.

38. (Previously presented) The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 37, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are fund managers.

39. (Previously presented) The method claimed in any one of claims 24 to 37, wherein said investments of the investment portfolio are direct shares.

40. (Currently amended) An analysis process, including __automatically comparing a distribution of assets of investments of an investment portfolio over one or more asset classes with a distribution of assets over said one or more asset classes associated with a benchmark risk category representing a risk tolerance level of the investor, and generating a comparison metric indicative of the degree of correspondence between said distributions, wherein said comparison metric is used to guide subsequent modifications to the investment portfolio__.
